primitives.name: Public Record Witness
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Job 1 — The public record needs a witness (highest value) The product's entire claim is that its record is checkable.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'timestamp (seconds since Unix epoch)', 'S': 'settlement event (binary: win/loss)', 'T': 'third-party timestamping authority (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Settlements are atomic, timestamped by a non-falsifiable third party; public access to records is guaranteed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T = false, S becomes unverifiable; when t is missing, S lacks temporal anchoring.

layer2.mapping: Each settlement S(t) maps to a Bayesian belief update in GSI, while GSE tracks S(t) as a deterministic state transition in a causal graph.
layer2.telemetry: Timestamp validity and settlement visibility across public interfaces

primitives.name: Distribution Surface Linking
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Job 2 — Distribution (medium value, real) Every post links to a surface.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L': 'link to surface (URL string)', 'R': 'referral conversion rate (dimensionless)', 'F': 'first repeat visit (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each post contains a valid surface URL; referral tracking is implemented with persistent identifiers.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When L is malformed or inaccessible, R drops to zero; F fails if no session tracking occurs.

layer2.mapping: Distribution links form a directed graph in GSE, where edge weights represent referral conversion probabilities; GSI uses this to infer user intent and behavior.
layer2.telemetry: Click-through rate on links and conversion to first repeat visit

primitives.name: Community Methodology Focus
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Job 3 — Community (the owner's ask — and the one to be most careful with) There is a real appetite on X for a *methodology* community: people who want to talk about calibration, closing line value, sample size and variance rather than locks.
primitives.assumptions: Methodological discourse increases trust; engagement is measured via interaction metrics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When M = false, C decays; V grows without bounds if no calibration is enforced.

layer2.mapping: Community focus M maps to a probabilistic model refinement in GSI, while GSE treats it as a feedback loop in agent behavior.
layer2.telemetry: Engagement on methodological posts and variance reduction in predictions over time
